endpoint: whole-body total endogenous secretion including basal
reference: full observed schedule; an analysis reference, not biological truth
subsets: two or three development-selected proper subsets of actual times, preserving 0 and 120
masking: opaque raw CSV cells removed before shared analyte parsing, conversion, initialization, uncertainty and estimation
shared_clock_admission: required_times_min; missing requests invalidate the visit before estimation
reuse: same fixed kinetics, uncertainty settings, keyed retained-time perturbations, execution and native report reader
failures: all planned people, visits, schedules, variants and perturbations retained
precision: descriptive sample SD of reduced-minus-reference differences; not a confidence interval for bias
low_values: show all observed minima, assay LOQ and censoring without a default clinical cutoff
